definitions.explanation: a dining arrangement where customers pay a fixed price to eat as much as they want within a time limit

examples.japanese: 2000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼肉|やきにく}→焼肉：04984_yakiniku⟧{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}だ。
{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦バイキング→バイキング：21783_baikingu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to an all-you-can-eat cake buffet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制限時間|せいげんじかん}→制限時間：30577_seigenjikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧90⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}だ。
examples.english: It's all-you-can-eat with a 90-minute time limit.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to eat) + ⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ (as much as one wants)

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ～⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ pattern is productive:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}→飲み放題：08308_nomihoudai⟧ (all-you-can-drink)
- ⟦{歌|うた}い→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ (all-you-can-sing/karaoke)
- {見|み}⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ (watch all you want, e.g., streaming)
- {乗|の}り⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ (unlimited rides)

TYPICAL FEATURES:
- Fixed price (⟦{定額|ていがく}→定額：09740_teigaku⟧)
- Time limit (⟦{制限時間|せいげんじかん}→制限時間：30577_seigenjikan⟧) - usually 60-120 minutes
- May have extra charges for premium items
- Often penalty fees for leftover food

ALTERNATE TERMS:
- ⟦バイキング→バイキング：21783_baikingu⟧ (Viking - used for buffets in Japan)
- ⟦ビュッフェ→ビュッフェ：11156_byuffe⟧ (buffet)
